name: apr-saas
description: SaaS Multi-Tenant B2B para APR/SSR en Chile (Ley 20.998 - Subsidio SAP)

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin,pwa -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @apr/api" "npm run dev -w @apr/web-admin" "npm run dev -w @apr/pwa-operador"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @apr/api && npm run build -w @apr/web-admin && npm run build -w @apr/pwa-operador
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @apr/api && npm run typecheck -w @apr/web-admin && npm run typecheck -w @apr/pwa-operador
